subject: Re: TideWave private offer — anchoring, SKU packaging, and channel evidence
messages:
From: Maria Santos <maria.santos@tidewave.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: TideWave Procurement <procurement@tidewave.com>
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer kickoff — TideWave usage & channel margin question

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We’re ready to move from discovery toward a private offer (AWS Marketplace) for TideWave’s analytics product. A few items for the pricing/packaging team to confirm before we lock anchor numbers: 

- We need clarity on whether you recommend a flat list-price anchor or a bucketed (node-hour / node-tier) SKU structure for our projected 12–18 month ramp. Our main goal is predictable unit economics while preserving burst capacity.
- TideWave sells through a distributor (Northpoint) and requires a 20% reseller margin to be applied at invoice to downstream partners. Can Redwood support a pass-through reseller margin (and evidence) rather than embedding the margin in list price?
- Procurement will need an evidence packet for channel netback and invoice routing (SOW, distributor details, and a simple channel margin workbook).

I’ve attached our current SOW and forecast. Would you be able to share an initial private-offer draft and the channel-workbook you’d like us to fill? If possible, we’d like to close pricing by EOW and aim for a June private-offer publication.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a 30m call if that helps.

Cheers,
Maria Santos
Head of Procurement, TideWave
procurement@tidewave.com

Attachment: TideWave_SOW_v2.docx (docx, 412 KB)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Maria Santos <maria.santos@tidewave.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@tidewave.com>
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 12:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer kickoff — TideWave usage & channel margin question

Hi Maria — great to hear and thanks for the SOW.

Short answers up front:
- Recommendation: for your profile (steep initial ramp, predictable baseline + spikes), we usually recommend a hybrid SKU: a committed-bucket anchor (monthly node-hour commitment) + a metered overage SKU. This keeps list-price deterministic for procurement while protecting burst economics.
- Reseller margin pass-through: yes — Redwood supports distributor pass-throughs. We do not bake a reseller margin into the SKU; instead we publish a private-offer anchor and attach an invoice routing instruction so Northpoint can be paid the agreed 20%. We’ll provide the necessary channel netback evidence workbook.

I attached an initial private-offer draft (PDF) with a proposed anchor and a short channel workbook template for you to populate. Quick asks: can you confirm Northpoint’s tax ID and whether TideWave wants Northpoint as the invoice recipient or as a listed distributor (two different routing flows)? That will change whether we route payment or simply include distributor metadata on the invoice.

Available for a 30m slot tomorrow afternoon (PST) if you want to walk through the workbook.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Partner & Marketplace Sales, Redwood Inference
mailto:priya_natarajan@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: Redwood_Private_Offer_TW_v1.pdf (pdf, 128 KB)
Attachment: channel_margin_workbook.xlsx (xlsx, 45 KB)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 May 2025 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Private offer kickoff — TideWave pricing & channel evidence (internal)

Ben / Olga — forwarding TideWave’s note and the SOW. They asked specifically for:

- confirmation that we can do a 20% reseller margin pass-through to distributor Northpoint (they prefer pass-through vs embedding in list price).
- a channel netback workbook with the invoice routing options documented (invoice to Northpoint vs invoice to TideWave with distributor metadata).
- a quick anchor we can publish as a private offer (they want to close pricing this week).

Proposal in the attached workbook:
- Anchor (committed bucket): $180k/month (covers up to 10k node-hours). Overage priced at $0.018/node-hour.
- If we support pass-through, I propose we keep the anchor as-is and record Northpoint as the invoice recipient in the private-offer metadata. That keeps list-price clean and preserves TideWave’s desired 20% margin.

Olga — can you validate the netback calc in tab 'DistributorFlow' and confirm if the invoice-routing option will require any extra bookkeeping (tax handling, VAT fields) on our side?

Ben — if we publish this anchor, any objections to offering a 3-month early-adopter credit (10% credit on first 3 months) to smooth their ramp? That will affect recognized revenue but is a common concession.

Thanks — Priya

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 May 2025 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private offer kickoff — TideWave pricing & channel evidence (internal)

Priya / Ben — reviewed the workbook. Notes below (I left comments in the DistributorFlow tab):

- Distributor pass-through: supported. We can mark Northpoint as invoice recipient in the private-offer metadata, and we’ll emit the invoice payable to Northpoint. This keeps TideWave’s list-price unchanged and preserves the channel netback.
- Tax/VAT: if Northpoint requires invoicing in their name, we need their tax ID and country. For US domestic distributors we only need the EIN; for EU/APAC we’ll need VAT IDs and potential reverse charge handling.
- Netback numbers: if TideWave wants Northpoint to receive exactly 20% of the invoice amount, we need to confirm whether that 20% is computed on list price or net-of-credits. If the 10% early-adopter credit applies, distributor payout will be 20% of the net after credit unless TideWave wants the distributor to be made whole (we can model both).
- Revenue recognition: marking invoice to Northpoint will change billing flow but not affect our revenue recognition policy; however, we should document the early-adopter credit waterfall so accounting can map the gross-to-net.

I updated channel_margin_workbook.xlsx and attached it here. Priya — Ben, recommend we propose both options to TideWave and call out implications in one slide (short).

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Director, Deal Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachment: channel_margin_workbook.xlsx (xlsx, 58 KB)

From: Maria Santos <maria.santos@tidewave.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <c.ruiz@tidewave.com>, TideWave Procurement <procurement@tidewave.com>
Date: Sat, 24 May 2025 16:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer kickoff — TideWave pricing & channel evidence

Hi Priya — thanks for the quick turn and for looping finance. We reviewed the anchor and Olga’s notes. A few confirmations: 

- TideWave is happy with the anchor as proposed (committed $180k/month, $0.018/node-hour overage) and we’ll accept the 3-month early-adopter credit.
- We prefer Northpoint to be the invoice recipient (they will be paid directly) — their US EIN is 12-3456789. Please include Northpoint in the invoice metadata and route payment accordingly.
- For the distributor payout calculation: TideWave wants Northpoint to receive 20% of the gross invoice (pre-credit). If you can model both options, we’ll sign the one where Northpoint is made whole on gross.

Next steps: please send a DocuSign-ready private-offer (we’ll circulate internally and provide a PO). Also send the channel netback workbook with your modeled scenarios so our finance team can sign off.

If you can get the DocuSign link and the updated workbook by Monday morning PST, we’ll push this through our procurement queue.

Appreciate it — Maria

Maria Santos
Head of Procurement, TideWave
